name: @castellan/wasm
description: The shared Rust logic compiled to WASM: what the extension runs in-browser, the apps link natively

scripts.//: build runs wasm-pack against crates/wasm; declarations are committed, while artifact tests need the runtime output.
scripts.build:wasm: sh -c 'wasm-pack build ../../crates/wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/wasm/src/pkg --scope castellan; status=$?; rm -f src/pkg/.gitignore; exit $status'
